INTRO_KR: TPV Technology, originally Admiral Overseas Corporation, was founded in Taiwan in 1967. In 1989, CEO Dr. Jason Hsuan decided to establish a factory in Fuqing, Fujian, marking TPV's entry into mainland China. Over the years, TPV evolved from a small display manufacturer to a global leader in smart manufacturing, with 12 factories and an annual output of around 50 million units, generating over 50 billion RMB in revenue. The company has maintained the world's top position in monitor shipments for 20 years, holding about 30% market share, while its TV shipments consistently rank among the top 10 globally. In March 2023, TPV received the prestigious 7th China Industry Award, and in July 2023, it ranked 217th on the Fortune China 500 list. TPV operates under a dual-track OBM/ODM business model, designing for major brands and producing its own brands like AOC and AGON. Committed to innovation, TPV has won numerous awards, including the Red Dot and CES Innovation Awards. Looking forward, TPV aims to transition to smart manufacturing by 2025. After being dual-listed in 1999 and privatized in 2019, TPV underwent asset restructuring with Nanjing Huadong Electronics, officially renaming to "TPV Technology Co., Ltd." in May 2021, re-entering the mainland Chinese stock market.
